request.style: English, male voice, solo, gravelly, acoustic guitar, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, soulful, melancholic yet hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We know in all things He works for our good
For those who love Him according to His purpose
He foreknew us and predestined our shape
Conformed to the image of His own Son

[Pre-Chorus]
He predestined and He called us through
Those He called He has also justified
And those He justified He has glorified

[Chorus]
What then shall we say to all of this
If God is for us who can be against us
He did not spare His own Son for us all
How will He not freely give us everything

[Verse]
Who will bring a charge against the chosen
It is God who justifies the soul
Who is there to condemn us in the end
Christ Jesus died and was raised again

[Pre-Chorus]
He is at God's right hand now
Interceding for us in the holy place
No condemnation remains in our face

[Chorus]
What then shall we say to all of this
If God is for us who can be against us
He did not spare His own Son for us all
How will He not freely give us everything

[Bridge]
Who will separate us from the love of Christ
Hardship or distress or persecution here
Famine and nakedness and danger near
The sword cannot break what He has sealed

[Chorus]
What then shall we say to all of this
If God is for us who can be against us
He did not spare His own Son for us all
How will He not freely give us everything

[Outro]
If God is for us
No one can be against us
